facts.text: I am looking for data on my company's organizational structure.
I want to know how many departments my company has.

I realized that my company has a total of 100 leadership positions across the company.
I plan to reach out to HR to see if they have information on my company's organizational structure.

I want to create a more inclusive leadership team.
